claims.statement: Alexandria, Virginia issues citations for gas-powered leaf blower use by residents and contractors from November 17, 2026.

sources.quote: Effective November 17, 2026, citations for use of gas-powered leaf blowers will be issued for residents and contractors.

claims.statement: Frequently mowed lawns generally support lower plant biodiversity and provide less value for wildlife than meadows.

sources.quote: Due to the high cutting frequency, lawns generally support lower plant biodiversity and provide less value for wildlife than meadows.
